_readme: ORGANISERS PAGE TEXT. "organisers" is the list of organisations — copy a { ... } block to add one. Each one shows a logo and the name under it, nothing else. "name" is written the same way in every language, so it is one plain line, not hy/en. "logo" is a picture file inside images/ — put the file there and write its name here. Keep names short: they must fit on one line.
